label: warm_history_65bb40e

design.comparisonBoundary: fixed read path, fixture-warm state, single-host local topology end-to-end increment from non-empty history

workload.exactMessage: hello, can you tell me about delivery times

measurementBoundary.included: MySQL history read and row decoding, durable-history validation, token estimation and whole-pair trimming, prompt construction, and request serialization on the fixed delivery/read path
measurementBoundary.excluded: fixture construction, base setup, host quiet checks, and model inference; the deterministic fake LiteLLM fixture answers immediately
measurementBoundary.loadStatement: 10 requests/second is the measurement load, not a capacity claim

acceptanceGate.criteria: each run has zero k6 dropped iterations, HTTP errors, failed turns and processing turns; iteration, boundary, completion, distinct-session, profile, context and routing counts agree; one formal request per session; fixture context arrays and source/runtime/setup identities match the frozen contract
acceptanceGate.identityBoundary: every run was rebuilt from the same CityBuddy source commit and independently verifies its source/nonce labels plus equality of that run's host and mounted JAR hashes; binary and image hashes are not asserted to be identical across runs
